list.name: Phase changes
list.query:
from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "throughput_A")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "phase"])

targets.query:
from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "throughput_A" or r._field == "throughput_B")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "queue_A" or r._field == "queue_B")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "delay_A" or r._field == "delay_B")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Inside Count (vehicles in corridor) per side

targets.query:
from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "inside_A" or r._field == "inside_B")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "throughput_A")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "phase"])
  |> rename(columns: {phase: "_value"})
  |> last(column: "_value")

from(bucket: "corridor")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "corridor_tick")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "throughput_A")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "mode"])
  |> rename(columns: {mode: "_value"})
  |> last(column: "_value")
